name: Bedrije
text:
Fwd: Trampoline
The springs are shot and two have snapped, so the frame is taped off. The new set is in the shed, ask Bedrije for the spanner box.

name: Zesch
text:
Forwarded from the ticket office
The panto run is extended a week after the first block sold out. Sales reopen Monday at ten on the phone line and at the window. Extra dates are on the board, codes with Zesch.

name: Trajko Aylén
text:
Fwd: Sailing club
Berths on the summer pontoon are allocated and the waiting list has cleared at last. Dinghy storage fees stay flat and the crane day is the last weekend of April. Tenders must be off the hard before the dredging barge arrives, keys from Trajko Aylén.

name: Sarah Johnson
text:
Forwarded from the clinic
The flu clinic moves to the main hall next week, so enter by the ramp door. Letters are not needed, ask Sarah Johnson at the desk.

name: Laurena
text:
Fwd: Tool hire
The breaker and the mixer went back to the hire shop on Friday and the deposit came through. The compactor is out until Thursday, and the extension leads need testing before they go out again. Ring Laurena if the delivery slot slips.

name: Holzinger
text:
Forwarded from the mill
Flour deliveries move to Tuesdays and Thursdays while the bridge is closed, and the early run will use the ford when the level allows. Orders for the bake house must reach the office by four the day before. The mill shop stays open on Saturdays, and short loads go on the claim sheet for Holzinger.

name: Kanyaphat Dugar
text:
Fwd: Recipe box
The old canteen index has been scanned and put in the archive box. Borrow the copy from the shelf, and clip the lid down for Kanyaphat Dugar.

name: Zanlucchi Abdirahmani Palmiteri
text:
Forwarded from the stable yard
Farrier day moves to the 14th because the vet is on site that morning. Hay is booked, so keep the top gate clear for the lorry. Head collars are with Zanlucchi Abdirahmani Palmiteri.

name: Adília
text:
Fwd: Pottery kiln
The second kiln is down to one element and firing times have doubled. The workshop moved the mug orders across and glazes run in the evening. The element set is on order from Stoke, fitting is booked for the 9th. Check rush jobs with Adília before promising them.

name: Buchner
text:
Forwarded from the print room
The label rolls came cut to the wrong core and the pallet goes back. Use the plain stock, pickup is with Buchner.

name: Samim Biron
text:
Fwd: Sports hall
Badminton courts are re-marked on Thursday and the net posts are being replaced. The juniors move to the small hall, and the club night starts at seven. The booking sheet is at the desk, queries to Samim Biron.

name: Ndione Conzetti
text:
Forwarded from the surgery
Repeat prescription requests now take two full working days, so order before noon to avoid a weekend gap. The online form is preferred but the paper slips still work and go in the box by the hatch. Pharmacies collect at eleven and four. Phone queries go to Ndione Conzetti.

name: Lieta
text:
Catering catch up
Two freezer units are out of scope for the refit so the stock stays put.
The new till rolls land Monday.
Contact list is with Lieta.

name: Tesfagabr
text:
Branch sync
Two vacancies are out to advert and the closing date is the 22nd.
The window display changes on the 1st, posters are in the stockroom.
Staff parking permits renew this year.
Till audits move to the close of play, sheet checked by Tesfagabr.

name: von Jenner
text:
Production freeze
The line changeover overran by two hours because the new guards did not fit the old frame.
Maintenance ground the brackets overnight and the fit is good now.
Waste figures for the month came in well under target.
Handover notes are with von Jenner.

name: Gobiga Monireh
text:
Kitchen notes
The walk in fan is noisy again and the seals were swapped Tuesday.
Prep list moves to the board by the pass.
Diet sheets are with Gobiga Monireh.

name: Fania
text:
Volunteer rota
Two stewards needed for the Saturday market, names to the office by Thursday.
The van passes are renewed and live in the drawer by the till.
Sign in book returns to the desk, checked by Fania.

name: Tesfaledet
text:
Safety walk
Escape routes were checked on both levels and two boxes were moved out of the corridor by the print room.
The extinguisher beside the loading bay is due a service and has been tagged.
Floor tape at the top of the ramp is lifting, replacement ordered.
The register is signed, next walk is with Tesfaledet.

name: Parameswaran Sugikanthan
text:
Waste review
Skip swaps move to Fridays and the cardboard contract runs to March.
Glass collections stay fortnightly.
Contact for the depot is Parameswaran Sugikanthan.

name: Bukies Arbogast
text:
Library meeting
Summer reading challenge packs are ready and the volunteer sign up sheet is on the desk.
The overdue reminder texts go out weekly now instead of daily.
Quiet room bookings rise in exam season.
Accounts checked by Bukies Arbogast.

name: Nayil
text:
Fleet review
Two vans are due their safety inspections this month and both are booked for the same Tuesday.
The courtesy car agreement is renewed with the same terms.
Fuel cards are being reissued.
Tracking units were tested and all report in fine.
The long term hire stays on the road until the new order lands, schedule held by Nayil.

name: Covacich
text:
Open day planning
Hall hire is confirmed and the bouncy castle is booked.
Parking marshals needed for the morning.
Licence copy is with Covacich.

name: Kieren Lanza
text:
Weekly sync
Two of the three quotes for the fence came back and the third is chasing.
The gate hinge was greased and the post replaced at the corner.
Paving slabs for the path are on order.
Site photos are filed with Kieren Lanza.

name: Lerand Casamento Baraghini
text:
Seminar planning
The venue holds eighty and the catering quote is per head with a two week deadline.
Speaker confirmations are complete, slides are due a week before.
The poster goes to print once the title is fixed.
Badge printing will run in house to keep costs down.
Registration desk rota is with Lerand Casamento Baraghini.

name: Sevdai
text:
Fwd: Bike shed
The padlock was cut by the fire officer and the spare is in the office. Sign for the new one when it arrives.
Thanks,
Sevdai

name: Erdöközi
text:
Forwarded from the archive
The deeds for the north field have been digitized and the originals are back in the strongroom. Two maps need flattening under weights. Leave requests in the tray at the desk.
Regards,
Erdöközi

name: Martignetti Vanheiden Zadehnour
text:
Fwd: Resin order
The casting resin came in short again and two of the hardener bottles were leaking. The supplier has been told with photos, and the replacements go on the next pallet. Until then keep the workshop on the slower cure mix and log any waste so the credit claim is accurate.
Thanks,
Martignetti Vanheiden Zadehnour

name: Dorith Mohniuc
text:
Fwd: Quiz sheets
The answer sheets from last month were binned by mistake. Rebuild them from the question bank before Thursday.
Thanks,
Dorith Mohniuc

name: Valdecir
text:
Forwarded from the boatyard
The mooring lines for the visitor berths have been replaced and the old ones are in the skip. The fuel dock card reader is offline, so take cash or use the office terminal.
Regards,
Valdecir

name: Pimpão
text:
Fwd: Milking parlour
The vacuum pump is losing pressure on the far side and the liner set was changed. The engineer has the pump on the bench and the test should run tomorrow morning, so the afternoon milking moves half an hour later. Any cows held back go through the small parlour instead.
Thanks,
Pimpão

name: Gabriel-Ioan Naveau
text:
Fwd: Piano
A castor on the upright has collapsed and the case tips when it rolls. The tuner fits the new set on his next visit.
Thanks,
Gabriel-Ioan Naveau

name: Senarigo Al-Askari
text:
Forwarded from the canteen
The soup urn has been descaled, so the winter menu restarts on Monday. Gluten free bread comes in on Tuesdays and Fridays, keep it on the top shelf. The allergen sheet needs initialling after each bake.
Thanks,
Senarigo Al-Askari

name: Zardasht
text:
Fwd: Orchard netting
The wind tore a section of netting off the top wire and the cherries are open to the birds. The roll in the barn should cover it but the staples are the wrong length, so pick some up from the farm store. Two posts at the corner are leaning and may need replacing.
Thanks,
Zardasht

name: Tona
text:
Forwarded from the studio
The backdrop roll has a crease and the steamer is out of fluid. Use the grey sheet as a fallback and reorder both.
Thanks,
Tona

name: Inci Trubrig
text:
Fwd: Loom room
The warp beam on loom 3 slipped its brake and the tension went slack across the width. The brake pad was replaced and the warp retensioned. Keep the humidifier topped up, the threads get brittle when it runs dry.
Thanks,
Inci Trubrig

name: Shelby Dan-Dumitru
text:
Forwarded from the climbing gym
The lead wall holds are being reset for the competition and the auto belays are out of service until Friday. Members can use the bouldering room at no extra cost and the booking sheet is on the app. The youth squad session moves to the evening slot.
Thanks,
Shelby Dan-Dumitru

name: Linarello
text:
Fwd: Locker audit
Twelve lockers are out of use pending repair and the key list has been updated. Padlocks left after Friday are cut off.
Thanks,
Linarello

name: Minh-Duc
text:
Depot briefing
The new scanner rollout starts Monday and the training is in the canteen at seven.
Bay allocations are unchanged for the week.
The loading spikes near the ramp have been painted.
Thanks,
Minh-Duc

name: Diako
text:
Systems review
Backups finished clean and the restores were spot checked on two folders.
The old tape drive is off the contract and ready to leave the rack.
Two accounts still have shared passwords, both owners have been emailed.
The document store migration slipped to the 30th.
The action list is pinned by the door.
Thanks,
Diako

name: Yingsel Ellaya
text:
Garden share
Seed swap went well and the spare packets are in the shed drawer.
The water rota needs two more names.
Thanks,
Yingsel Ellaya

name: Peró Contarin Radiskovic
text:
Ward handover
Two bays were curtained off after the deep clean and both reopen after lunch.
The drug trolley count balanced on both shifts.
The discharge letters are checked and ready to post.
Thanks,
Peró Contarin Radiskovic

name: Kristof
text:
Boiler house
The weekly blowdown was done on both units and the water readings are back in range.
The dosing pump was replaced after it lost prime twice.
Fuel delivery is booked for Wednesday and the tank was dipped today.
The standby generator ran its load test without a fault.
Thanks,
Kristof

name: Darragi
text:
Early round
All stops were done by nine and the depot sheet is signed.
The van needs a wash before Friday.
Thanks,
Darragi

name: Chandra Dalton
text:
Safety committee
Three near misses were logged this month and all were slips on the wet ramp.
The ramp is being gritted on the morning rounds now.
Two first aid kits need restocking and the order is in.
Thanks,
Chandra Dalton

name: Romig Coram
text:
Allotment committee
Plot 9 has been strimmed back and the shed swept out ready for the new tenant.
The water trough by the gate was rewashered and the tap no longer drips.
Fence posts along the boundary path are on the list for the autumn, timber is priced.
Thanks,
Romig Coram

name: Edrian
text:
Kitchen close
The fryer was filtered and the floor mopped behind the range.
Prep for the morning is in the walk in.
All doors checked, alarms on.
Thanks,
Edrian

name: El-Gharbawy
text:
Staff forum
Two questions came in about the car park charges and both were answered by the survey results.
The suggestion box moves to the canteen door.
Committee elections run at the end of the month, nomination slips are at the desk.
Thanks,
El-Gharbawy

name: Ravena Diana-Lavinia
text:
Festival wrap
Ticket sales beat the target and the extra gate covered the security costs.
Lost property from the site was sorted and two phones went back to owners.
The stage crew cleared the field by lunchtime on Sunday and the fencing is back in the yard.
Accounts will be settled this week.
Thanks,
Ravena Diana-Lavinia

name: Olindo Buckovic
text:
Pool check
Chlorine and pH were in range all week and the backwash ran Monday.
The lane ropes were swapped on the deep side.
Thanks,
Olindo Buckovic

name: Ghiglia
text:
Harvest plan
The combine is booked for the 8th and the grain trailer passed its check.
The drier gas is topped up.
The store has room for the first two loads, so the rest goes to the co-op.
Thanks,
Ghiglia
